name: 五代十国
feature: 唐亡后中原五代更替、周边十国并立。列中原五代主要君主（十国并立不计入），合计53年。
featureEn: After Tang fell, the Central Plain saw five dynasties in turn and ten kingdoms around. Major Central Plain rulers (ten kingdoms not counted), 53 yrs.
summary: 大分裂尾声，武人乱政，终由宋重新统一。
summaryEn: The tail of great division; warlord misrule, finally reunified by Song.

emperors.nEn: Zhu Wen, Taizu of Later Liang
Zhu Youzhen, Last Emperor of Later Liang
Li Cunxu, Zhuangzong of Later Tang
Li Siyuan, Mingzong of Later Tang
Li Congke, Last Emperor of Later Tang
Shi Jingtang, Gaozu of Later Jin
emperors.noteEn: Ceded the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan–Yun

emperors.nEn: Shi Chonggui, Emperor Chu of Later Jin
Liu Zhiyuan, Gaozu of Later Han
Liu Chengyou, Hidden Emperor of Later Han
Guo Wei, Taizu of Later Zhou
Chai Rong, Shizong of Later Zhou
Chai Zongxun, Respectful Emperor of Later Zhou

文臣.noteEn: Served many dynasties; an unshakeable politician

其他.noteEn: Last lord of Southern Tang; the emperor of ci

policiesEn: The Sixteen Prefectures ceded to the Khitan

政治: 武人乱政，藩镇割据延续
中原五代更替，周边十国并立
经济: 南方相对安定，经济重心继续南移
吴越等地海外贸易与商业活跃
文化: 雕版印刷推广（如《大藏经》）

政治: Five dynasties in the Central Plain; ten kingdoms around
经济: The south was relatively calm; the economic center kept moving south
Overseas trade and commerce thrived in Wuyue etc.
文化: The rise of ci poetry (Li Yu of Southern Tang)
